_format.description: Risk classifier golden cases (docs/integrations/claude-code.md 7). The classifier input is tool_name, tool_input, cwd and permission_mode. Output: level, reasons, extra_confirmation. The overall level is the highest level of any matching rule over all command segments (split on && ; |); 'reasons' is the exact set of reason codes of the rules that match at that highest level (reasons of lower levels are not listed). permission_mode 'plan' raises write tools (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) by one level (capped at critical). extra_confirmation follows the level (low/medium none, high hold, critical hold_and_reconfirm). Order of reasons is not significant.

fields.rule: the reason code this case is about
fields.polarity: positive: rule must be in reasons; negative: rule must NOT be in reasons
fields.tool_name: Claude Code tool name (or Codex item type for agent=codex; Codex shapes are UNVERIFIED (Phase 0 C8/C10))
fields.cwd: session working directory (Windows or POSIX style)
fields.expand: optional: JSON-pointer -> {repeat, count}; replace the string at that pointer by repeat*count before classifying (keeps the file small)
fields.inject: optional: 'classifier_panic' makes the classifier fail internally; the result must still be critical/classifier_error
fields.unverified: optional, true for Codex shapes not yet verified

_format.note: 'git branch -D' vs '-d' cannot be told apart after the documented lower-casing normalisation, so the safe-delete spelling is intentionally not a negative case.
